name: eng-2348
title: Warn when Roam sharing or importing is used with Stored Relations disabled

prepare.why: the extension has a proof database session for this graph; the proof database runs without edge functions, so this signs in the way create-space would
Stored Relations is off, the state the warning is for

cases.title: Discover shared nodes warns while Stored Relations is off
cases.proves: Done When 1: The warning appears before sharing or importing with Stored Relations disabled.
cases.caption: With Stored Relations off, the import dialog now says so up front and links to the setting.

steps.why: open import the way a user would

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => proof.callout('Stored relations are disabled'), { what: 'the Stored Relations warning in the import dialog' })

cases.title: Share current node warns while Stored Relations is off
cases.proves: Done When 1: The warning appears before sharing or importing with Stored Relations disabled.

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => proof.callout('Stored relations are disabled'), { what: 'the Stored Relations warning in the publish panel' })

cases.caption: Publishing a node shows the same warning before anything is shared.

cases.title: Semantic search and similar-node sync stay available
cases.proves: Done When 3: Semantic search and similar-node sync remain available.
cases.intent: With Stored Relations still off, run node-search.open, search for 'PK baseline', and check that the baseline nodes show and no sync error appears.

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.waitFor(() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bp3-dialog [role="option"]')).some((el) => el.innerText.includes('PK baseline')), { what: 'the baseline nodes in the results' }); proof.assert(!/error|fail/i.test(proof.toastText()), 'A toast reports a problem: ' + proof.toastText()); })()
expect.text: Node Search returns results, and no sync error shows, while Stored Relations is off.

cases.caption: Search keeps working with Stored Relations off: Node Search still finds the baseline nodes, and no sync error shows.

steps.why: open Node Search the way a user would

cases.title: Turning Stored Relations on removes the warning
cases.proves: Done When 2: Enabling Stored Relations removes the warning.
cases.caption: Turn Stored Relations on, and the warning is gone.

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.sleep(800); proof.assert(!proof.callout('Stored relations are disabled'), 'The warning still shows with Stored Relations on.'); })()
